players.name: Auston Matthews

Projection: ordinary shooting regression and better health can restore first-round-caliber goal and shot production even if his absolute offensive environment is less certain after Toronto's roster changes.

scoringCautions: He is already priced as an elite asset, so the bounce-back case does not create a large margin for error.

Projection: his per-game upside remains elite, but an ADP in the mid-60s can overstate season-long totals because the market must absorb a meaningful expected absence plus reintegration risk.

scoringCautions: Season-long roto formats with limited IR are more exposed to missed games.
Shoulder recovery can affect shooting and contact tolerance even after clearance.
